front: In nested loops, how often does the inner loop run completely?
back: Once for every round of the outer loop. With an outer loop of 3 rounds and an inner loop of 4 rounds, the inner body runs 3 × 4 = 12 times.
For each value of `row` the inner loop runs completely before `row` moves on, so the output goes `1 1`, `1 2`, `2 1`, `2 2`.
The `if` inside the loop is checked for every element. Only temperatures above 20 print a message.
The outer loop visits each row of the grouped data, the inner loop visits each number inside that row, so every value is added once.

front: Does `print("done")` run once or once per round?
back: Where it is indented decides. Inside the inner loop it runs once per inner round, inside only the outer loop once per outer round, and at the left edge once at the end.
